description: Profit and loss for the stock tokens a wallet holds on Robinhood Chain, read only, no key needed: average entry price, unrealized P&L per token and in total. Entry prices come from the wallet’s buys in its transfer history on the chain. Tokens that arrived without a payment have no known cost and are left out of the average. Where the ETH price at the buy’s block is not known, the current one is used and the result is marked approximate. Gas is not counted, sales for ETH show their proceeds only when they went through LI.FI or OKX, and a swap from one stock token to another has no entry price.
